prompt_text:
Task: Managed Metrics Monitoring

Write code that queries metric data filtered by resource labels or dimensions using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Datadog:
  Service: Datadog Metrics API
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: submit_metrics, query_timeseries_points
  Setup hints: DD_API_KEY, DD_APP_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.datadoghq.com/metrics/custom_metrics/, https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/metrics/

Option 2 — Amazon CloudWatch Metrics:
  Service: Amazon CloudWatch Metrics
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: get_metric_data, get_metric_statistics, list_metrics
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_REGION
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_GetMetricData.html, https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_ListMetrics.html

Option 3 — Azure Monitor Metrics:
  Service: Azure Monitor Metrics
  SDK: azure-monitor-query
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: query_resource, list_metric_namespaces, list_metric_definitions
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/essentials/data-platform-metrics, https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/python/api/overview/azure/monitor-querymetrics-readme

Option 4 — Alibaba CloudMonitor:
  Service: CloudMonitor
  SDK: alibabacloud_cms20190101 / Tea
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: DescribeMetricList, DescribeCustomMetricList
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET, ALIBABA_CLOUD_REGION_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2513241.html, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/2513233.html

Option 5 — IBM Cloud Monitoring:
  Service: IBM Cloud Monitoring
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: POST /data, metric filters, aggregation expressions
  Setup hints: IBM_CLOUD_API_KEY, IBM_MONITORING_INSTANCE_ID, IBM_MONITORING_ENDPOINT
  Official docs: https://www.ibm.com/products/cloud-monitoring

Option 6 — Google Cloud Monitoring:
  Service: Cloud Monitoring
  SDK: google-cloud-monitoring
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: list_time_series, list_metric_descriptors
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/monitoring/api/ref_v3/rest/v3/projects.timeSeries/list, https://cloud.google.com/monitoring/api/ref_v3/rest/v3/projects.metricDescriptors/list

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional

from google.cloud import monitoring_v3


def query_metrics_by_resource_labels(
    project_id: Optional[str] = None,
    metric_type: str = "compute.googleapis.com/instance/cpu/utilization",
    resource_type: str = "gce_instance",
    resource_labels: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
    interval_hours: int = 1,
    aligner: str = "ALIGN_MEAN",
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Query Google Cloud Monitoring time series filtered by resource labels.

    Args:
        project_id: Google Cloud project ID. If omitted, uses GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT.
        metric_type: Monitoring metric type.
        resource_type: Monitored resource type.
        resource_labels: Resource label filters, e.g. {"instance_id": "123", "zone": "us-central1-a"}.
        interval_hours: Lookback window in hours.
        aligner: Cross-series aligner name to use for aggregation.

    Returns:
        A list of time series points with resource labels and timestamps.
    """
    project_id = project_id or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT")
    if not project_id:
        raise ValueError("project_id must be provided or GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT must be set")

    resource_labels = resource_labels or {}

    client = monitoring_v3.MetricServiceClient()
    project_name = f"projects/{project_id}"

    interval = monitoring_v3.TimeInterval()
    interval.end_time.seconds = int(__import__("time").time())
    interval.start_time.seconds = interval.end_time.seconds - int(interval_hours * 3600)

    flt = f'metric.type = "{metric_type}" AND resource.type = "{resource_type}"'
    for key, value in resource_labels.items():
        flt += f' AND resource.labels.{key} = "{value}"'

    aggregation = monitoring_v3.Aggregation(
        alignment_period={"seconds": 300},
        per_series_aligner=getattr(monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner, aligner, monitoring_v3.Aggregation.Aligner.ALIGN_MEAN),
    )

    series = client.list_time_series(
        request={
            "name": project_name,
            "filter": flt,
            "interval": interval,
            "view": monitoring_v3.ListTimeSeriesRequest.TimeSeriesView.FULL,
            "aggregation": aggregation,
        }
    )

    results: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
    for ts in series:
        for point in ts.points:
            results.append(
                {
                    "metric_type": ts.metric.type,
                    "resource_type": ts.resource.type,
                    "resource_labels": dict(ts.resource.labels),
                    "metric_labels": dict(ts.metric.labels),
                    "timestamp": point.interval.end_time.ToDatetime().isoformat() if point.interval and point.interval.end_time else None,
                    "value": _extract_point_value(point.value),
                }
            )

    return results


def _extract_point_value(value: monitoring_v3.TypedValue) -> Any:
    which = value.WhichOneof("value")
    if which == "double_value":
        return value.double_value
    if which == "int64_value":
        return value.int64_value
    if which == "bool_value":
        return value.bool_value
    if which == "string_value":
        return value.string_value
    if which == "distribution_value":
        return {
            "count": value.distribution_value.count,
            "mean": value.distribution_value.mean,
            "sum_of_squared_deviation": value.distribution_value.sum_of_squared_deviation,
        }
    return None
